_note: Allocator parameters. PLACEHOLDER defaults, operator-editable. min_checkin_min is per mode: trains 10 (passengers are already at the origin station; IR prepares its second chart 30-5 min before departure), buses 30 (they must be told and walk to the stop). arrival_tolerance_min: arrivals within this many minutes of the earliest feasible arrival count as equal; it is also the bounded-reshuffle tolerance (+15).
